desc: 205 P2 (Mythos): does the REAL fault clear with TLB maintenance? Diagnostic kernel = daily301 feature set + patches/t6040-205-fault-tlbi-retry-diag.patch (kbuild T6040_FAULT_DIAG=1). In __do_kernel_fault, after fixup/spurious checks: on an EL1 data-abort WRITE permission fault at a linear-map VA whose current PTE is valid and not PTE_RDONLY: stage 1 log CPU/VA/PA/PTE/ESR + local_flush_tlb_all (tlbi vmalle1; dsb nsh; isb) and return to retry; stage 2 (same VA, same CPU faults again) flush_tlb_all broadcast + retry; stage 3 log AGAIN and fall through to the unchanged Oops. Diagnostic only, never a fix. Harness = 5011's deterministic one: thin dcuart DTB + 217 initramfs-cow-report + control m1n1 bf4b2462, maxcpus=6 (2/2 control boots Oops on CPU 5 at ~21 ms in the initramfs unpack). Launcher scripts/t6040-run-cow-report.sh control 6 (IMAGE/IMAGE_SHA256 override; early exit 30 s after a pre-reproducer Oops; RESULT reports diag stage counts). Readout: stage-1 success = stale private-TLB entry; stage-2 success = stale entry that only a broadcast clears; AGAIN = not TLB. 2 fresh boots; maxcpus=2 x1 if time. No storage writes, no new hardware write class (TLBI only).
